annotations.text:
StockScan · client review 1/3 — daily scanning

Flow: pick your name → choose the mode once (F1–F4) → scan → type pieces or cartons → Enter.

Please confirm:
• Are STOCK IN / SALE / RETURN / ADJUST the four actions your staff need?
• Do staff count in cartons (ISI)? If never, the CTN switch is hidden.
• Selling more than the recorded stock is allowed with a warning and flagged for the admin. OK?
• StockScan will ship in English, 中文 and Bahasa Indonesia. Please check the Bahasa Indonesia page and tell us if any wording feels unnatural.

Figures for CK-EM296, CK-EM196 and SM-K805 come from the EMERGENCY report. Other products, barcodes, names and counts are sample data.

StockScan · client review 2/3 — inventory & history

• Current stock = ACCURATE baseline + StockScan live change, so anyone can see why StockScan differs from ACCURATE.
• Undo never deletes. It adds a reversal line (see Amy, 14:13 in History).

Please confirm: which columns do you need in the stock export and the transaction export?

StockScan · client review 3/3 — data & setup

Please confirm:
• ISI = pieces per carton? KOLI = stock ÷ ISI? Which price is HARGA (selling, purchase, other)?
• Can ACCURATE export a barcode ↔ product list? If not, staff link each barcode once in Barcode Setup.
• Do cartons carry their own barcode (one scan = a full carton)?
• When you export a new report from ACCURATE, does it already include the StockScan changes you entered?
• Is there a fixed Excel/CSV template for entering StockScan data back into ACCURATE?
• Should damaged returns go to Gudang Rusak instead of sellable stock?

Versi Bahasa Indonesia · Indonesian version

Istilah: MASUK / JUAL / RETUR / KOREKSI untuk mode, PCS / KOLI untuk satuan, format angka Indonesia (1.284 · 0,46).
Mohon satu staf gudang mengecek apakah istilahnya sudah wajar.

Terms: MASUK / JUAL / RETUR / KOREKSI for the modes, PCS / KOLI for units, Indonesian number format. Please ask a warehouse staff member whether the wording feels natural.
